gloss: selfishness; doing as one pleases; willfulness

definitions.gloss: selfishness; doing as one pleases; willfulness
definitions.explanation: Behaving according to one's own wishes without regard for others. Used both as a noun and as a na-adjective to describe selfish behavior or a self-centered personality.

examples.japanese: {我|わが}{勝手|かって}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{我|わが}{勝手|かって}で、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{迷惑|めいわく}→迷惑：02432_meiwaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えない→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: He is always selfish and doesn't think about the trouble he causes others.

examples.japanese: {我|わが}{勝手|かって}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません→申し訳ありません：21409_moushiwakearimasen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}して→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧⟦いただけません→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: I'm sorry for the selfish request, but would it be possible to change the schedule?

notes:
A compound of {我|わが} (one's own; my) and ⟦{勝手|かって}→勝手：03021_katte⟧ (one's own convenience; selfishness). Functions as both a noun ({我|わが}{勝手|かって}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧) and a na-adjective ({我|わが}{勝手|かって}な).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {我|わが}{勝手|かって}な⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い→振る舞い：10520_furumai⟧: selfish behavior
- {我|わが}{勝手|かって}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say selfish things; to make selfish demands
- {我|わが}{勝手|かって}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a selfish person
- {我|わが}{勝手|かって}な⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧: a self-serving reason

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦わがまま→わがまま：03789_wagamama⟧: selfish; spoiled — more common in everyday speech, slightly childish nuance
- ⟦{身勝手|みがって}→身勝手：14345_migatte⟧: selfish; self-centered — stronger negative connotation
- ⟦{自分勝手|じぶんかって}→自分勝手：19490_jibunkatte⟧: doing things one's own way — very close synonym, more colloquial
- ⟦{自由勝手|じゆうかって}→自由勝手：26586_jiyuukatte⟧: acting freely as one pleases — less negative, implies freedom rather than selfishness
